<h5 class="card-title">Budget Gatekeepers & Federal Transfers</h5>
<p class="card-text">Deciphering the mechanisms of federal public budget articulation through econometric modeling and Network Analysis. Investigates party bargaining power and "coalition bonuses" in resource distribution to Brazilian municipalities by mapping bipartisan financial flows and calculating Betweenness Centrality.</p>

<h5 class="card-title">Administrative Unilateralism in Latin America</h5>
<p class="card-text">Large-scale computational research investigating institutional dynamics across Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Colombia, and Paraguay. Involves developing automated web scraping bots to extract over 150,000 normative acts and applying NLP (Named Entity Recognition) to decode raw official decrees.</p>

<div class="card-body d-flex flex-column">
<h5 class="card-title">Stakeholder Mapping: Fiscal Framework</h5>
<p class="card-text">Quantitative assessment of political risk and transaction costs in the National Congress. Modeled roll-call votes for the Fiscal Framework (PLP 93/2023) using the Jaccard Similarity Index and Louvain clustering to detect invisible behavioral caucuses and strategic gatekeepers.</p>
